solutions.title: Recursive descent
solutions.strategy: Parse a segment until its closing bracket, recursively expanding nested bracketed groups.

timeComplexity.explanation: The parser reads n encoded characters and appends r decoded characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Recursion depth d and output builders store nested work and decoded text.

solutions.title: Explicit stack
solutions.strategy: Push the previous builder and repeat count at each opening bracket, then expand at each closing bracket.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each encoded character is processed once and each decoded character is appended once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Stacks store nested builders/counts and the decoded output.
